# Feather cape

Internal ID: CapeFeather | Type: Cape | Source: Galdr table | Crafting Materials: Feather x6, Scale hide x15, Refined eitr x9 | Armor: 4 | Resistances: Feather fall | FireFrost

# Introduction

Feather cape is a craftable Armor piece that grants the Feather fall effect consisting of 100% fall damage reduction and fall speed limited to 5 m/s. It provides resistance to frost, however it is very weak against fire. To counter this weakness, it is best to equip a Fire resistance barley wine when fighting enemies with Fire damage, such as a Gjall or the Dvergr fire mage.
This cape is ideal for traversing the rough valleys of the Mistlands terrain where one can climb tall rocks and glide over obstacles. "Sprinting" while gliding affects the falling angle, but also consumes Stamina.
